prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE standalone premium CGI industrial miniature scene for a Chinese-language logistics brand's desktop landing-page concept review, S01-A China departure port. 16:9 landscape composition, preferably 2048 x 1152 pixels.
Scene: an imaginary modern outbound port container yard. Foreground pale concrete yard and restrained kraft cartons on pallets; midground a straight transport road with a navy logistics truck, carefully arranged containers, and a loading operation; background simplified clean white and light-gray warehouse volumes, a port crane and a restrained hint of distant water. All operations plausible and orderly. Sparse tiny workers wearing high-visibility PPE, no identifiable faces.
Style: refined architectural visualization with convincing industrial surface scale, precise seams, brushed metal, subtle concrete grain and corrugated steel; coherent dimensional miniature spatial depth, sophisticated materials, never shiny toy plastic, clay, handcrafted diorama or low-poly.
Camera: medium-wide three-quarter view at modest elevation, strong layered foreground/midground/background, grounded horizon, not top-down. Main transport/loading action concentrated in center-right. The LEFT 35 percent is deliberately quiet, pale concrete and soft sky with very little detail, reserved for later Chinese HTML copy. No copy is burned into the image.
Daylight: soft neutral late-morning sunlight, readable directional shadows, pale warm-gray sky, high-key but physically grounded lighting, no night or neon.
Palette: predominantly white and light-gray concrete, navy structures and vehicles, kraft brown pallets/cartons, controlled vivid cyan #00ABE1 on selected container surfaces and ONE physical route stripe across the yard leading forward toward the loading operation. No green branding.
Logo preparation: provide ONE clearly readable large blank light-neutral rectangular sign panel on a facility or container facing the camera around the middle-right, in mild perspective with unobstructed room around it. The panel is an integral physical part of the scene, sufficient for later exact official logo compositing. Leave the panel wholly blank. Do not add any logo or brand characters.
Strict exclusions: absolutely no generated text, numbers, logos, emblems, iconography, watermarks, signage lettering or pseudo-characters anywhere. No actual identifiable facility, port landmark, company, third-party logo or address. No green logos, diagonal reference symbols, SF holograms, crowds, unsafe work, dirty clutter, extreme zoom or dramatic road turns. This is symbolic concept art, not evidence of a real company's infrastructure.
Input note: no reference image supplied to this call; visual direction is textual only.
reference_note: REF-STYLE-01 not sent; local view_image failed with sandbox helper error. Textual brief from coordinator used.

notes: Daylight white/navy/cyan port, clean left-side copy field and large blank physical façade sign.
Operation and scale read as realistic industrial CGI; miniature stylization is subdued and requires review.
No legible generated brand text seen; tiny cargo handling marks may exist at incidental detail size.
This base is unbranded and is not a final accepted keyframe.

output_hint:
Generated images are saved to C:\Users\KIM TAEHYUNG\.codex\generated_images\01a0a021-4224-74b0-a0b9-1dcf99cccc20 as C:\Users\KIM TAEHYUNG\.codex\generated_images\01a0a021-4224-74b0-a0b9-1dcf99cccc20\exec-390ebc96-3ef9-407e-ad4e-aca01b7181b5.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
